caption: Name any exam → get a practice coach
text: This is Make My Own Exam. Name any exam, and it builds you a practice coach. Here, the GRE essay.

caption: Step 1 · Muse searches the web for official sources
text: Meta's Muse model searches the web for the official materials: the question pool, the scoring guide, and scored samples. Then it reads every page and PDF it finds.

caption: Questions · Scoring rules · Research
text: It collected every official GRE topic and the zero to six rubric. It also found research by the test makers, and checked each paper against Crossref.

caption: Any exam: AP · IELTS · US civics · …
text: The same pipeline works for other exams. AP U.S. History, IELTS writing, and the U.S. citizenship test were each built from one sentence.

caption: Step 2 · Practice
text: Then you practice. Pick a question, start the timer, and write.

caption: Scored on the exam's own rubric
text: Muse grades the answer on the exam's own rubric. Every comment quotes a sentence from your answer, so you can see exactly what it's reacting to.

caption: Concrete revisions
text: And it ends with concrete revisions.

caption: What to practice next
text: Nobody can predict your exact question. Insights shows where the pool's weight sits, and what to practice next.

caption: Short answers, checked against the official answer
text: It works for short answers too. On the U.S. citizenship test, every answer is checked against the official answer from USCIS.

caption: IELTS · official band descriptors, 0 to 9
text: For IELTS, it restated the official band descriptors, so essays are scored on bands zero to nine, with the same kind of feedback.

caption: Or bring your own agent over MCP
text: Prefer your own agent? One prompt installs Chrome DevTools on Chrome Canary and this site's MCP server, so your agent collects the exam. Another lets it grade your answer.

caption: Collected and graded by a Claude agent over MCP
text: This exam was collected from u s c i s dot gov by a Claude agent driving Chrome Canary, and saved through MCP. And this essay was graded by the agent with its own model, then saved back the same way.

caption: Muse by default · your own key · your own agent
text: Muse is the default, or plug in your own API key. Make My Own Exam. Bring any exam.
